description: Search Austrian case law (Judikatur) in ONE court or tribunal per call — court is required: vfgh (Constitutional Court), vwgh (Supreme Administrative Court), justiz (ordinary courts incl. OGH, selected decisions), bvwg (federal administrative), lvwg (state administrative), dsk (data protection authority), normenliste (VwGH norm index), dok, pvak, gbk, verg, upts (party transparency), and the historical uvs, asylgh, ubas, umse, bks. Cross-court research is one call per court (calls are cheap); historical bodies are closed windows with successors — codes, windows, and Geschäftszahl examples: ris_list_reference topic courts. Filter by full-text query, cited norm ("DSG §1", "DSGVO Art32" — the highest-value filter), exact case_number (Geschäftszahl), decision date range, decision_type (headnote vs full text), decision_kind, or the court-conditional filters: issuing_body (dsk/dok/pvak/verg), court_name/legal_area/subject_area (justiz), state (lvwg/uvs), party (upts), commission/senate/discrimination_ground (gbk), subject_law (bks), collection_number (vfgh/vwgh/uvs). For a known Geschäftszahl or VfSlg/VwSlg cite, ris_lookup_citation resolves it directly.

case_number.description: Exact Geschäftszahl — returns that decision’s documents. Formats differ per court (examples: ris_list_reference topic courts). Not available for normenliste. Omit to leave unfiltered; a blank value is rejected.

changed_since.description: Coarse recency filter — decisions changed in RIS within the interval. For exact windows use ris_track_changes.

collection_number.description: Official collection number (Sammlungsnummer). vfgh, vwgh, and uvs only, and the accepted form differs: vfgh and uvs store the bare number and match it dotted or undotted ("19632", "19.632"), while vwgh stores the full labelled undotted cite — pass "VwSlg 18000 A/2010", or the space-anchored prefix "VwSlg 18000 *" when the part letter or year is unknown. A bare or dotted number matches nothing under vwgh. Omit to leave unfiltered; a blank value is rejected.

commission.description: Equal-treatment commission (gbk only): federal (Bundes-Gleichbehandlungskommission) or general (Gleichbehandlungskommission).

court.description: Which court/tribunal application to search — one per call. Codes, coverage windows, and successor mapping: ris_list_reference topic courts.

court_name.description: Filter within the ordinary courts (justiz only) — "OGH", "OLG Wien", "LG Linz". Omit to leave unfiltered; a blank value is rejected.

decided_from.description: Earliest decision date (YYYY-MM-DD). Not available for normenliste.

decision_kind.description: Decision kind (Entscheidungsart) — per-court value sets, validated locally: ris_list_reference topic decision_kinds. No such parameter exists for normenliste, dok, pvak, umse, bks, or upts. For justiz the four documented values are not yet populated in the corpus (every value returns 0 hits, verified 2026-07-05) — filter justiz with query or norm instead. Omit to leave unfiltered; a blank value is rejected.

decision_type.description: Search headnotes (Rechtssätze), full decision texts (Entscheidungstexte), or both (all, the default). Not available for gbk, upts, or normenliste.

discrimination_ground.description: Discrimination ground (gbk only): Alter (age), EthnischeZugehoerigkeit (ethnic origin), Geschlecht (gender/sex), Mehrfachdiskriminierung (multiple grounds), Religion (religion), SexuelleOrientierung (sexual orientation), Weltanschauung (worldview/belief). Upstream German enum values, sent verbatim.

issuing_body.description: Deciding body (EntscheidendeBehoerde) — dsk, dok, pvak, and verg only. dsk: Datenschutzbehoerde (2014+) or Datenschutzkommission (up to 2013). Full value lists: ris_list_reference topic issuing_bodies. Omit to leave unfiltered; a blank value is rejected.

legal_area.description: Legal area (Rechtsgebiet, justiz only): civil (Zivilrecht) or criminal (Strafrecht).

norm.description: Cited-provision filter (Norm) — "DSG §1", "DSGVO Art32", "GewO 1994 §129", matching the format returned in norms_cited. The highest-value case-law filter. Omit to leave unfiltered; a blank value is rejected.

page_size.description: Documents per page: 10 or 20 (default 20). For more results, keep the size and raise page.

party.description: Political party the decision concerns (upts only). Documented values: ÖVP, SPÖ, FPÖ, KPÖ, BZÖ, Team Stronach — the filter is full-text, and further party names appear in live data (e.g. "Wandel"). Omit to leave unfiltered; a blank value is rejected.

query.description: Full-text search over decisions (Suchworte). Boolean UND/ODER/NICHT or AND/OR/NOT, quoted phrases, trailing-only * wildcard. Omit to leave unfiltered; a blank value is rejected.

sort_by.description: Sort column. Default: upstream order. Not available for court: normenliste, which indexes laws rather than decisions.

state.description: Which of the nine state administrative courts/senates to search (lvwg and uvs only).

subject_area.description: Subject-area taxonomy filter (Fachgebiet, justiz only) — 39 exact German values like "Datenschutzrecht", validated locally: ris_list_reference topic justiz_subject_areas. The corpus carries no tagged documents yet (every value returns 0 hits, verified 2026-07-05) — filter with query or norm instead until RIS populates the tags. Omit to leave unfiltered; a blank value is rejected.

subject_law.description: Media statute the case concerns (Bereich, bks only) — e.g. "ORF-Gesetz", "Privatradiogesetz". Omit to leave unfiltered; a blank value is rejected.

name: ris_search_case_law

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `court_filter_mismatch`: A court-conditional filter was sent with the wrong court, or case_number/dates/decision_type were sent with normenliste (a norm index, not decisions) — rejected locally before any upstream call; the message names the offending pair. `invalid_query`: A page past the last page of results, or a parameter value that failed validation — decision_kind/subject_area checked locally against the reference tables, sort_by rejected locally because court normenliste indexes laws rather than decisions, or RIS rejected the value in-band (message passed through verbatim, in German, and it does not name the page). `upstream_error`: RIS is unreachable, returned a server error, or served an HTML error page. `upstream_timeout`: RIS did not answer the search within the request deadline. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Zero-hit guidance — names the likely cause and the concrete next call.

results.description: Matching documents for the requested page — decisions, or indexed laws under court normenliste. Totals and paging in enrichment.

items.description: One document from the selected court — a decision (headnote or full text), or, under court normenliste, one law of the VwGH norm index (see norm_index).

case_numbers.description: Case numbers (Geschäftszahl) — a decision can carry several.

collection_number.description: Official collection number (VfSlg/VwSlg/UVS Sammlungsnummer), where assigned.

content_urls.description: Rendition URLs of the main document.

pdf.description: PDF rendition URL (the only rendition for upts).

court.description: RIS application code of the deciding body (e.g. Vfgh, Justiz, Upts) — use as the application argument of ris_get_document.

decision_kind.description: Decision kind (Entscheidungsart — Erkenntnis, Beschluss, …), where tagged.

decision_type.description: Document kind: 'Rechtssatz' (headnote) or 'Text' (full decision text). One decision may appear as several headnote documents plus one text document sharing a Geschäftszahl.

decision_url.description: RIS web view of the complete decision (GesamteEntscheidungUrl).

document_number.description: Technical RIS document number (e.g. JFT_…, DSBT_20251114_…, UPTS_…) — pass together with the court value (as application) to ris_get_document.

ecli.description: European Case Law Identifier, where assigned.

guiding_principle.description: Guiding legal principle / headnote (Leitsatz) — the abstracted rule the decision establishes. Present chiefly on Rechtssatz (headnote) documents, mostly VfGH.

headnotes_url.description: RIS web view of the decision’s headnotes (RechtssaetzeUrl).

indexes.description: Systematik classification entries (Indizes) — the same taxonomy ris_search_legislation filters on, so an entry copied here finds the consolidated law around the decision. Carried by vfgh, vwgh, lvwg, uvs, umse, and normenliste; empty for the rest.

items.description: One Systematik index entry, e.g. "10/10 Datenschutz".

norm_index.description: The law this record indexes. Present only for court normenliste (the VwGH norm index); absent for the sixteen deciding courts, whose records describe a decision instead.

abbreviation.description: Citable short form the VwGH uses for the law, e.g. "DSG 2000", "HlG 1989", "KFGNov 21te".

reference.description: Promulgation reference of the law (Fundstelle), e.g. "BGBl I 165/1999" — resolve it with ris_search_gazette or ris_lookup_citation.

title.description: Full title of the law as the index records it (Titel) — often several lines, carrying the parliamentary references and originating gazette.

type.description: Norm type code (BG, V, K, …) — glossary: ris_list_reference topic law_types.

norms_cited.description: Norms the decision cites — copy an entry verbatim into the norm filter to find sibling case law.

items.description: One cited norm in RIS format, e.g. "DSG §1".

note.description: Annotation (Anmerkung) — a renaming or lifecycle note on a normenliste law, an editorial note on a justiz or dsk decision.

party.description: Political party the decision concerns (upts decisions only).

state.description: Bundesland whose administrative court decided (lvwg and uvs records) — the German name, e.g. "Tirol".

totalCount.description: Total matching documents across all pages.

truncated.description: Present and true when more pages exist beyond this one — raise page to continue.

title: Search Austrian Case Law
